scripts.install:apps: npm --prefix apps/backend install && npm --prefix apps/backend-admin install && npm --prefix apps/frontend install && npm --prefix apps/frontend-admin install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:public-backend" "npm run dev:public-frontend" "npm run dev:admin-backend" "npm run dev:admin-frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:admin-backend && npm run build:public-frontend && npm run build:admin-frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:admin-backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:admin-backend && npm run lint:public-frontend && npm run lint:admin-frontend
scripts.audit:production: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=low && npm --prefix apps/backend audit --omit=dev --audit-level=low && npm --prefix apps/backend-admin audit --omit=dev --audit-level=low && npm --prefix apps/frontend audit --omit=dev --audit-level=low && npm --prefix apps/frontend-admin audit --omit=dev --audit-level=low
